description: Core 5th grade standards. No negative numbers, no algebra, no ratios. Whole numbers, fractions, decimals, basic geometry, and coordinate plane in Quadrant I only.

templates.problem: Movie tickets cost ${a} each. A family buys {b} tickets. How much do they spend in all?
Find the product of {a} and {b}.
How much greater is {a} × {b} than {c} × {d}?
Maya multiplies {a} × {b}. Her work shows {a} + {b}. What is the correct product?
templates.generation_note: student added instead of multiplying; correct = a*b

templates.problem: A basketball player scores {a} points in each of {b} games. How many points did the player score altogether?
Find the missing factor: __ × {b} = {p}.
Pack A has {a} packs of cards with {b} cards in each. Pack B has {c} packs with {d} cards in each. How many more cards does the larger pack set have?
A rectangular garden is {a} feet long and {b} feet wide. What is the area of the garden in square feet?
A road trip covers {a} miles over {b} days with the same distance each day. How many miles are driven each day?
Which quotient is greater, and by how much: {a} ÷ {b} or {c} ÷ {d}? Enter the positive difference.
templates.constraints_note: a divisible by b; c divisible by d

templates.problem: A video game has {a} gems to unlock equally across {b} levels. How many gems are unlocked on each level?
Divide: {a} ÷ {b}
A shelter has {a} dog treats to share equally among {b} dogs. How many treats does each dog get?
Team A splits {a} stickers among {b} players. Team B splits {c} stickers among {d} players. How many more stickers does each player on the team with the larger share get?
templates.constraints_note: a divisible by b; c divisible by d

templates.problem: What is {a} divided by {b}?
Jordan solves {a} ÷ {b} and writes {b} as the answer. Jordan swapped the dividend and the divisor. What is the correct quotient?
templates.constraints_note: a divisible by b; a/b != b

templates.problem: Find the missing divisor: {a} ÷ __ = {q}.
templates.constraints_note: a divisible by q; answer is a/q

templates.problem: Sam has ${a}, then buys {b} snacks that cost ${c} each. How much money does Sam have left? Use {a} - {b} × {c}.
templates.constraints_note: a > b*c so answer is positive

templates.problem: How much greater is {a} × ({b} + {c}) than {a} × {b} + {c}?
A team earns {a} points, then scores {b} goals worth {c} points each, and later loses {d} points. What is the final score: {a} + {b} × {c} - {d}?
Alex evaluates {a} + {b} × {c}. Alex's work shows ({a} + {b}) × {c}. What is the correct value?
templates.generation_note: student added first; correct multiplies first

templates.problem: The expression {a} + __ × {c} equals {r}. What number goes in the blank?
You buy items costing ${a}.{b} and ${c}.{d}. What is the total cost?
A ribbon is {a}.{b} meters long. You cut off {c}.{d} meters. How much ribbon is left?
How much greater is {a}.{b} than {c}.{d}?
Item A costs ${a}.{b} and item B costs ${c}.{d}. How much more does the more expensive item cost?
A swimmer's times for three laps were {a}.{b} seconds, {c}.{d} seconds, and {e}.{f} seconds. What was the total time?
A student adds {a}.{b} + {c}.{d} incorrectly by misaligning the decimal places. What is the correct answer?
templates.generation_note: wrong = a+c concatenated wrong (e.g. misaligned decimals)

templates.problem: Round {a}.{b} to the nearest whole number.
templates.constraints_note: b < 5 so rounds down to a

templates.problem: A recipe uses {a}/{b} cup of milk and {c}/{d} cup of cream. How much liquid is needed in total?
A board is {a}/{b} meter long. You cut off {c}/{d} meter. How much board is left?
templates.generation_note: ranges enforce a/b > c/d so remaining length is positive

templates.problem: A recipe needs {a}/{b} cup of sugar and {c}/{b} cup of brown sugar. How much sugar is needed in total?
A rain gauge collected {a} millimeters on Monday and {b} millimeters on Tuesday. How many millimeters were collected in all?
{a}/{b} + __ = {c}/{b}. What is the missing fraction?
Find {a}/{b} - {c}/{b}.
A student adds {a}/{b} + {c}/{d} incorrectly by adding numerators and denominators separately. What is the correct answer?
templates.generation_note: wrong = added numerators AND denominators separately

templates.problem: A shelter has {a} dogs. {b}/{c} of them got walks today. How many dogs got walks?
How much greater is {a}/{b} than {c}/{b}?
A recipe uses {a}/{b} cup of butter per batch. How much butter is needed for {c} batches?
You have {a}/{b} of a pound of chocolate. You split it equally among {c} friends. How much does each friend get?
__ × {a}/{b} = {c}/{d}. Find the missing number.
How much greater is {a}/{b} × {c} than {a}/{b} × {d}?
A garden is {a}/{b} of an acre. You plant flowers in {c}/{d} of the garden. What fraction of an acre has flowers?
A student computes {a}/{b} × {c}/{d} incorrectly by adding numerators and multiplying denominators. What is the correct answer?
templates.generation_note: wrong = added numerators and multiplied denominators

templates.problem: In the number {a}, what is the place value of the digit {d}?
templates.constraints_note: d appears in a at place 10^p; answer is d * 10^p

templates.problem: How much greater is {a} × 10^{b} than {c} × 10^{d}?
Round {a} to the nearest hundred.
Write the number with a {a} in the ten-thousands place, {b} in the thousands place, {c} in the hundreds place, {d} in the tens place, and {e} in the ones place.
A student computes {a} × 10^{b} incorrectly. What is the correct answer?
templates.generation_note: wrong = a * b (multiplied instead of using power of 10)
